goals: Keep canonical full leaves entirely provider-owned while making BGE-derived leaf geometry visibly bushy through provider-neutral, additive foliage.
Use BGE canonical bindings and exact exposed SurfacePatch geometry as the sole authority for material identity, resolved topology, and decorative attachment footprint.

Capture active final canonical leaf appearance into owned immutable values during public Fabric mesh iteration, without resource-path, registry-name, provider-specific, or renderer-owned-view retention.
scope: Canary 5 captures each canonical-root leaf BlockStateModel after ModelModifier.WRAP_LAST_PHASE, retains the clean BGE base model, and appends the existing authored two-sided slanted cards only over merged binding-owned surface patches.

During MeshView.forEach, C5 copies each selected canonical quad's UVs, colors, lightmaps, layer, emissive, diffuse/AO/shading/foil/animation metadata, tint, and tag into an immutable owned snapshot; card emission sees only that snapshot, explicitly uses the known world block atlas, and never retains or accesses a renderer-owned QuadView after its callback. Non-cull samples remain preferred and ordinary canonical leaf quads remain the fallback.

The generic path covers BGE horizontal Slabs, resolved Stairs and Walls, Vertical Slabs, Steps, Layers, Corners, and Quarter Columns; a centralized small-support rule scales or omits a motif without geometry-name branches.

exclusions: BGE remains unchanged and owns canonical material identity plus resolved SurfacePatch topology; BGE × CTM remains optional adjacent context, not a dependency or geometry authority.
No bushy-leaf resource-pack, mod, texture, model JSON, shader, provider class, or asset is copied, redistributed, or modified. The protected Minecraft testing profiles are not inspected or changed.

Inventory, hand, creative-menu, JEI, collision, outline, placement, drops, recipes, waterlogging, leaf distance/persistence/decay, rain drip, redstone, pathfinding, and BGE family membership remain untouched.
No registry-name inference, per-geometry ID list, Stair/Wall special branch, guessed cube halo, broad same-leaf decorative culling, or gameplay-state mutation is permitted.

dependencies.reason: C78 is the oldest required public BGE SurfacePatch capability that supplies authoritative resolved patches for every requested topology. C5 resolves the current-main BGE artifact solely as SHA-verified controlled build evidence, without a named-release runtime pin.
Canary 5 targets Minecraft Java 26.2 public block-model and renderer-quad interfaces.
Provides the public model-loading and renderer APIs used by the client-only C5 wrapper.

dependencies.reason: Owner runtime evidence confirms Foundation v2 visibly supplies the active full-block bushy leaves in the real stack. C5 samples whichever final canonical baked leaf appearance is active and does not package or depend on Foundation, Matcha, or another provider's resource path.
Minecraft 26.2 and the controlled build use Java 25.

Twenty-two focused synthetic/unit tests passed, including an instrumented MeshView whose source QuadViews become invalid immediately after each forEach callback. It verifies owned snapshot capture, decorative selection, post-invalidation card emission, copied UV/color/light/layer/emissive/AO/shading/foil/animation/tint/tag metadata, and zero post-invalidation source accesses; semantic, reload, deterministic patch-local, and BGE geometry fixtures also passed.

Controlled verification passed current-main BGE public-contract and Fabric renderer/model-loader hash gates, JAR metadata/required-class checks, 26-entry archive inspection, and provider-asset exclusion checks; it is not Minecraft visual/runtime evidence.

current.summary: Eliminates delayed renderer-owned QuadView access by emitting deterministic patch-local foliage from immutable captured appearance values.
